title: Refuse malformed host/native mailbox spellings before automatic discovery
outcome: Malformed exact-looking host/native addresses refuse before automatic directory admission in domain create/intent routes and the MCP resolver.
acceptance: A malformed exact-looking host/native reference is refused before automatic discovery/admission in affected create, intent and MCP resolution paths, without changing valid exact and alias contracts.
Focused counterexamples verify invalid target refusal leaves unrelated roots unbound and preserves mailbox/message/intent state; review and required gate evidence are carried.
